value.answer: Happy to point you the right way. For Toronto: if you want it free or cheap, Ontario Structured Psychotherapy offers free short-term CBT for adults with depression or anxiety, and Family Service Toronto has sliding-scale fees based on income. Private therapy isn't covered by OHIP, but lots of employer extended health plans cover it, and your workplace EAP may include a few free sessions a year. Private therapists may have openings within a week or two. Psychotherapy Referral Service has been matching people with registered psychotherapists since 1995. What kind of support are you after, and do you want public or private care?
